boundary.label: local-evidence
boundary.record: Chapter 13 and the saved ATS test rules
boundary.machine_can_verify: The report names the test and uses an allowed test mode.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether those rules are good enough for this assignment.

boundary.output: The PDF chosen for the ATS test
boundary.label: your-input
boundary.record: The file path typed in the command
boundary.machine_can_verify: The file exists, is a supported type, and is saved in an allowed place.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether it is the right PDF and is safe to use.

boundary.output: The software that reads the PDF
boundary.label: external-source
boundary.record: The installed PDF.js package and its saved version number
boundary.machine_can_verify: Which PDF reader and version actually ran.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether that reader is similar enough to a real company ATS.

boundary.output: The answer sheet for the public ATS example
boundary.label: record
boundary.record: The saved public résumé and its separate expected-field file
boundary.machine_can_verify: The expected text really appears in the public source résumé.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether the chosen fields cover the important parts of the résumé.

boundary.output: Text and page count taken from the PDF
boundary.label: script-output
boundary.machine_can_verify: The text it extracted and the number of PDF pages.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether the text still has the right meaning and whether the length is acceptable.

boundary.output: ATS field, order, and final PASS/FAIL results
boundary.label: script-output
boundary.record: The extracted text compared with the saved answer sheet
boundary.machine_can_verify: Which listed fields were found, whether they stayed in order, and the totals.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether a PASS means the résumé is ready for a real application.

boundary.label: script-output
boundary.record: The extracted text and the locations of text on each page
boundary.machine_can_verify: Basic reading problems and simple counts of headings, dates, and bullet-like lines.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether the résumé is complete and useful. These counts are not a quality score.

boundary.output: Warnings about what the ATS test cannot prove
boundary.label: local-evidence
boundary.machine_can_verify: The report shows its limits and does not make the final decision.
boundary.human_keeps: The final decision about the résumé.

boundary.output: Gate test rules and saved settings
boundary.label: record
boundary.record: Chapters 11 and 16, the saved test cases, and the real scoring program settings
boundary.machine_can_verify: The test used the same saved rules and settings as the real scoring program.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether the weight and cutoff are good enough for real decisions.

boundary.output: Identity and basic checks of the saved H-1B database
boundary.label: script-output
boundary.machine_can_verify: Which saved file was used, its size and shape, and whether its rate math is correct.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether companies were matched correctly when this file was created.

boundary.output: The one saved H-1B row used by the test
boundary.label: record
boundary.record: First complete H-1B record in stored CSV order
boundary.machine_can_verify: The company and numbers really occur in that saved row and its rate math is correct.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether that company was matched correctly. The original matching proof is missing.

boundary.output: The H-1B rate changed from percent to decimal for the test
boundary.label: script-output
boundary.record: The saved approval rate divided by 100
boundary.machine_can_verify: The conversion and the later score calculation.
boundary.human_keeps: This is only a test starting value, not the full chance of sponsorship.

boundary.output: Names and purpose of the three Gate test cases
boundary.label: local-evidence
boundary.record: The Gate test program and its saved test-case file
boundary.machine_can_verify: The names and descriptions were copied correctly.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether three cases cover enough possible mistakes.

boundary.label: script-output
boundary.record: The saved H-1B row, the chapter rules, and the real scoring program
boundary.machine_can_verify: The expected and actual results, every PASS/FAIL check, the totals, and the run time.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether the test inputs are true for a real job and whether more cases are needed.

boundary.output: Results from deliberately wrong Gate code
boundary.label: script-output
boundary.record: A saved bad version of the formula used only inside the test
boundary.machine_can_verify: The bad code produces the wrong Apply results and the test catches both.
boundary.human_keeps: Whether other kinds of bad code should also be tested.

boundary.label: local-evidence
boundary.machine_can_verify: The program leaves the final decision as HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
boundary.human_keeps: A named person must read the work and approve it.

boundary.output: Facts this project does not have
boundary.label: missing
boundary.record: No verified record is available in this project
boundary.machine_can_verify: The reports leave these items unknown or say NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
boundary.human_keeps: Find real evidence later or leave the answer unknown.

boundary.label: model-inference
boundary.record: The current public tests do not create an AI opinion
boundary.machine_can_verify: Test values are not presented as facts or AI opinions.
boundary.human_keeps: Check any future AI opinion against real evidence.

not_verified: truth or persuasiveness of a real resume
legal correctness of a personal visa timeline
weight calibration or final application worthiness
